reviews.text: I never thought I would have so much fun in a sim game.

Lovely game, really enjoyable but there is a couple issues.

1. Timer on the orders even on easy with unlimited time (can see it ticking down in the corner).
2. Being able to set the length of the day would be really nice. Sometimes it seems like we get 4 people for the duration. Wouldnt mind a longer day after all the prep.

The game is brilliant and I’m looking forward to more updates.
It’s as simple as inviting your friends using a code, and everything has gone smoothly so far.

An amazingly fun immersive experience. I'd love to see some extra immersive sim elements, too. The moment i was able to sit there with my friend and eat the Ramen we had prepared it really made me smile. SO often in games like this you can make something but never actually enjoy it. 

It's a bit weird that you LIVE in the Ramen shop. Like there are cots, but no other forms of entertainment to make it feel less like a sweat shop. Maybe add in some slice of life objects so we can turn the back room into an actual home instead of a sweat shop sleeper room? 

Fantastic job otherwise. The best part is, this is just an early access! Can't wait to see what you guys do with it! We'll be streaming the game!

overall a great game so far although there are a few quality of life things I would like like drawing tablet support for the designs, or being able to choose between sizes of grids for placements, and lastly a way to import/export images for the ingame designs (i think that feature might have been intended but it wasnt working for me). So far these are the only notes I have for the game in hopes that updates come, but for an initial release its impressed me
